content.title: Retail Challenges Hit Vera Bradley As Sales Drop Across All Channels
content.summary: Vera Bradley (NASDAQ:VRA) stock fell on Thursday after the handbag and accessories company reported a significant drop in fiscal second-quarter 2026 revenue, missing analyst estimates. The company’s consolidated net revenues from continuing operations fell 24.6% to $70.9 million, well below Wall Street’s forecast of $78.5 million.
